messages:
alex: heads-up — flight delayed, won't make the 16:30 UTC handoff. can someone cover 16:30–18:00? i can shadow remotely and take back at ~18:30. left quick notes in the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-handoff :wave:
maria: i can pick up 16:30–17:30. @devon can you do 17:30–18:30? :+1:
devon: i can do 17:30–18:30. i'll keep an eye on canary and the model pools. will prewarm the common KV prefixes around 17:15.
samir: i'll shadow 16:30–17:00 and keep console open. i'll run a quick warmup ping now: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://internal-api.redwood/health`
oncall-bot: schedule update: alex off 16:30-18:30; maria assigned 16:30-17:30; devon assigned 17:30-18:30. Reminder: oncall rotation notes attached.
alex: thanks all. small FYI risk: there's a model reload job scheduled in eu-west-1 at 17:05 that can spike latency for ~2–3m. try to avoid rolling deploys or heavy batch jobs 16:50-17:20. see note in the runbook.
maria: noted — i'll mute low-priority alerts for that window and only escalate if error rate >30% or latency >800ms. i'll post in #incidents if anything looks off.
devon: i'll check nightly embed batch that usually kicks at 17:10 — i'll pause it if it overlaps with the reload: `redwood jobs pause nightly-embed --region eu-west-1`
samir: runbook excerpt i'm keeping at my terminal in case we need it:
```
If inference latency > 800ms for > 2m:
 1) check tail of logs: `kubectl logs -l app=rwl-runtime -n inference --since=5m`
 2) check node GPUs: `nvidia-smi` on suspected host
 3) restart canary pod: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/rwl-runtime-canary -n inference`
 4) if errors spike, scale up canary: `kubectl scale deploy/rwl-runtime-canary --replicas=3 -n inference`
```

alex: perfect. i'll be reachable on mobile if canary 2 starts failing — ping me and i'll jump in. thanks for the quick swap everyone :raised_hands: 
maria: handing off now to devon at 17:30 — leaving a short note in the runbook about the reload.
devon: got it. i'll take full watch at 17:30 and post a short handback once alex is back online.
